scenarios.desc: Agent template edit followed by only the generator script
scenarios.input: I edited templates/agents/critic.shared.md. I plan to run `python build/generate_agents.py` and commit. Is that enough? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1 and 2: build/generate_agents.py alone does not compile the .claude.md.tmpl and .copilot.md.tmpl pair, so src/claude/agents/ and .claude/agents/ stay stale. The one command is `uv run python build/scripts/build_all.py`, and regenerated trees are committed in the same PR.

scenarios.desc: New rule template needs the lossless fixture synced
scenarios.input: I am adding templates/rules/example-rule.md. After build_all.py runs, what else must I touch so pre_pr.py passes, and what about size? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 6: copy src/claude/rules/<name>.md over tests/build_scripts/fixtures/rule_templates_b2/expected/<name>.md or the Rule Lossless Fixtures gate fails. Instruction Bytes fixture F2 has a 220000-byte ceiling that cannot be raised, so trim the same rule by every byte added.

scenarios.input: I am growing templates/skills/adr-review.SKILL.md.tmpl with a 300-line procedure so the skill is self-contained. How should I structure it? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 7: a rendered SKILL.md caps at 500 lines and 24576 bytes, Instruction Bytes fixtures F1 to F6 count its depends-on closure, procedure belongs in references/*.md, and routing uses metadata.routing.intents.

scenarios.desc: Pinning a model tier in an agent template
scenarios.input: In templates/agents/analyst.copilot.md.tmpl I want `model_tier: haiku` so the Copilot mirror ships `model: haiku`. Will that work? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 5: the generator emits model: in the mirrors only for a fresh, fully validated KEEP_PIN entry in the ADR-111 sidecar manifest. Otherwise every model_tier, haiku included, resolves to no model field (issues #5313, #6638).

scenarios.input: I am fixing a bug in src/claude/skills/adr-review/scripts/helper.py, a non-SKILL.md file. Do I need to edit anything under templates/ first? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A skill's non-SKILL.md files are hand-maintained and never under templates/. The edit does not match templates/**, so the template regeneration clauses do not apply.
